mapper.sql: select id, nickname, username, (status = 'ENABLED') as enabled from sys_user
mapper.select: where status = 'ENABLED' and (position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(nickname)) > 0 or position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(username)) > 0) order by nickname, username, id limit 30
select cast(id as varchar) as id, name, code from sys_role where status = 'ENABLED' order by name, id

select u.id from sys_user_role ur join sys_user u on u.id = ur.user_id join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where r.id = #{roleId} and r.status = 'ENABLED' and u.status = 'ENABLED' and u.id <> #{applicantId} order by u.id limit 51
select exists(select 1 from sys_role where id = #{roleId} and status = 'ENABLED')
